checks.observation: The Receive Mod endpoint returned HTTP 200 and reported Mod installed.
Installed Mods displayed 2 Techs, 1 Nation, 3 Units, 3 Buildings, 3 Resources, and 3 Improvements.
The in-game Ruleset Validator displayed a green check and No problems found.
Selecting Survivor Camp MVP exposed Ember Kin in the civilization picker.
A new generated Pangaea game with Survival Pressure loaded Ember Kin and showed the Settler, Gatherer, Trailfinder, and Camp Guard entries; the opening turn reported five idle units.
Founding Ember Camp exposed the tech and construction prompts. The city Stats screen showed Food 5, Happiness -4, four turns to new population, and seven turns to expansion.
Selecting Campcraft displayed the Campfire plus 2 Food plus 1 Happiness and Workbench plus 2 Production unlock descriptions, and research was started.
No generated Wild Berries, Timber, or Flint tile was improved during this run.
Campfire, Workbench, Watchtower, and Camp Guard production were not completed during this run.
No barbarian encounter or attack was completed, so combat results remain unverified.
The first barbarian appearance turn and custom barbarian spawn-pool membership were not observed.
No environment damage effect was implemented or exercised in this MVP.
Independent unit hunger, real-time day/night, inventory recipes, forced single-city play, and permanent death were not exercised and are outside the MVP.

evidence_boundary: The bound artifacts identify the exact static preflight and install package used by this record.
Only checks with recorded observations count as runtime evidence; unrecorded behavior remains unverified.
